app.name: Wanas
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.usernameHint: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore. Your username is private and is never listed in a public directory.
auth.temporarySessionHint: Encryption keys stay in memory only and are discarded when you close this tab. You will not be able to read these messages again on this browser.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
chats.empty: No conversations yet. Add a trusted contact to start chatting.
chat.notEncrypted: This conversation is not encrypted. Wanas will not send messages here.
chat.unableToDecrypt: Unable to decrypt this message on this device.
contacts.title: Trusted contacts
contacts.inviteHint: Share this private link or QR code. It works once and expires in 24 hours.
family.title: Family
family.name: Family name
family.childAccountHint: A child account can only talk to contacts you approve. You will not be able to read their private messages — Wanas does not offer hidden monitoring.
calls.title: Calls
calls.comingSoon: Start a voice call from inside a conversation with the 📞 button. Video calls are coming later.
settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteAccountConfirm: This permanently deactivates your account. Enter your password to confirm.
kids.whoToTalk: Who do you want to talk to?
mobile.messagingUnavailable: Encrypted messaging on this device is not available yet. Use the Wanas web app while native encryption support is being completed.
auth.serverUnavailable: Can't reach the Wanas server right now. It is probably paused for a moment (for example the computer running it is asleep or offline). We retry automatically every few seconds, or you can tap “Try again”.
auth.startNowHint: No sign-up needed. You'll get your own Wanas Code to share with family and friends.
me.shareNumber: Share this code so family and friends can add you. No phone number needed.
protect.title: Protect your account
protect.body: Right now only this device can open your account. Set a password so you can sign in on another device with your Wanas Code — and keep your account if this device is lost.
protect.done: Your account is protected. Sign in elsewhere with your Wanas Code and this password.
protect.banner: Protect your account with a password
contacts.requestSent: Request sent. You'll be connected when they accept.
contacts.invalidNumber: That isn't a Wanas Code (w and 4 digits, like w1122).
chat.tooLarge: That file is larger than 25 MB.
chat.dangerousFile: This kind of file can be harmful. Only open it if you trust the sender. Download anyway?
chat.micDenied: Microphone access was not allowed. Check your browser settings.
notify.title: Notifications
notify.previewHint: Off by default: notifications only say who wrote, so nobody glancing at your screen can read your messages.
notify.limit: Notifications arrive while Wanas is open or recently in the background.
notify.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. On iPhone, use the Wanas app or add the site to your Home Screen.
backup.title: Message backup
backup.body: Save a backup file of your message keys on this device so you can read earlier messages after switching phones. The file is protected by a password you choose and never uploaded to Wanas.
backup.passHint: At least 10 characters. Without it, the file can't be opened — Wanas can't recover it.
backup.saved: Backup file saved. Keep it somewhere safe on your phone or computer.
backup.restored: Restored {n} keys. Earlier messages are now readable on this device.
backup.wrongPass: Wrong password, or the file is damaged.
call.title: Voice call
call.micNeeded: Microphone access is needed for calls.
common.slowLoading: This is taking longer than usual. Check your connection or try again.
notify.limitApp: In the app, notifications arrive while it's open or recently in the background. To get them when it's closed, open Wanas from its Home Screen icon (Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen) and turn notifications on there.
notify.homeScreen: On iPhone: tap Share → “Add to Home Screen”, open Wanas from the icon, then turn notifications on here.
notify.background.on: On for this device: messages and calls reach you even when Wanas is closed. Notifications never show message text.
notify.background.serverOff: Closed-app notifications aren't enabled on the server yet.
notify.background.denied: Notifications are blocked for Wanas. Allow them in your device Settings → Notifications.
notify.background.error: Couldn't turn on closed-app notifications. Try again in a moment.
call.cameraNeeded: Camera and microphone access are needed for video calls.
call.speaker: Speaker
auth.networkError: Can't reach the Wanas server. Check your internet connection and try again. If it keeps happening, the server may be down for a moment.
auth.serverError: The server had a temporary problem. Try again in a minute.
auth.displayNameInvalid: That name can't be used. Try a shorter name without special symbols.
security.verifyNote: Messages and calls are encrypted between devices. Manually verifying your contacts' devices (comparing codes) isn't available yet, so devices are not shown as “verified”.
auth.firstLoad: First time only: setting up encryption on this device (about 8 MB). On mobile data this can take a minute; next time is faster.
session.unreachable: Couldn't restore your session because the server isn't responding. Your account and chats are safe and will come back as soon as the server is up.
settings.appearance.footnote: Themes change colours only. Screen order, type size and accessibility stay the same. This choice is saved on this device.
chat.pingWait: You can ping again in a few seconds
contacts.inviteFriendsHint: Share a code, a link or a QR
chats.addPerson: Add a person or start a group
chats.requestsWaiting: {count} contact requests waiting — tap to review
group.name: Group name
group.pick: {count} selected. Tick the people to add.
group.needs: Give the group a name and choose at least one person.
group.failed: Couldn't create the group. Try again.
